source.title: Goblin Tinkering
source.description:
I think it's safe to say our business relationship is already firmly established. I am the brains, you are the brawn. That's great, because I realized about thirty seconds ago that I am missing some critical components!

Here's a list of things I need based on these schematics, excluding all the gnomish garbage. I'll get these designs fixed up in the meantime. When you're back, we can get straight to work.
source.progress: Took you a while, I was starting to think those Scarlet Crusaders finally did you in. Did you get everything I asked for?
source.completion:
I should have known you would conveniently ignore the grocery list. How is a goblin supposed to get a bite around here? Whatever.

You will be pleased to know that I finished the schematic for my newest invention: the Tinkerbox! This device is innocuous on its own, but that's the whole point! All you need to do is cram a few carefully calibrated parts into the back panel and then, when you're ready, press the big red button!

What will happen? That's what you're about to find out!
